style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard midday sun
motion_rule: one clear action per window, only one of them moves at a time; the camera never carries a window alone, something in frame moves too; he never holds a pose, not even the last; the camera travels every window, no push in and no focus pull; new shot size every window; his flat tail slaps in speech too
character: a glossy brown beaver, huge orange incisors, a broad flat tail, smug and pleased with himself
second_characters: ONE plump muskrat in a peaked cap, never still
props: ONE stick lodge; ONE blank paper policy; ONE round red stamp; ONE log dam; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the water climbs the lodge every window; the policy soaks darker and tears at 5.65
environment: a sunlit river bend, a mud bank, a log dam beyond

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, smug satisfied patter, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: za-stra-ho-VAL stress last, ot po-ZHA-ra stress second, zhi-VU stress last, v va-DE stress last, ne go-RYU stress last, pri-SHLA va-DA both stress last, HAT-ki stress first, no ne go-RIT stress last
audio.pacing: not a word before 0.9; 0.9-2.7 one breath; one pause, 2.7-3.2; 3.2-7.2 one breath; after 7.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: mouth and orange incisors open on every syllable, not a voice over
audio.sfx: wood cracking, tail slaps, a stamp thud, rushing water, a splash

timeline.a: the muskrat whips a rope round a log and it cracks against the lodge
he kicks the lodge door open and scrambles out over the mud
he blasts off the mud and swings up the lodge wall, mud ripping past the lens
he swings the flat tail through the lodge, a stick snapping off at the lens
no words, he is out of frame. The muskrat slams the stamp down, red ink spraying up the lens
timeline.c: whip sideways along the bank to the paper

timeline.a: he cannons off the roof into the river, spray blasting at the lens
he slaps the water twice with the tail, spray sheeting above him
the muskrat rips the last log out and a wall of river blasts over the dam
timeline.c: over him, whip to the dam

timeline.a: he vaults onto the floating roof, sticks scattering off it
he swims at the camera till his face fills the frame
timeline.c: charge in with him to big close

timeline.a: no words. The current tears the lodge open and the roof spins away
the muskrat slaps the soaked policy at the lens and it sticks there
timeline.c: macro at the paper, whip off

timeline.a: the flood hauls him backwards down the river, spray blasting off
he winks as the water closes over him, the red stamp floating on top

must_appear: the stick snapping off at 1.8, the stamp slamming down at 2.7, the dam bursting at 4.75, the roof spinning away at 7.2, him winking as the water closes at 9.3
negative_prompt: night, low key, a still camera, a slow push in, a focus pull, a camera move with nothing moving in frame, anyone holding the mic, a second beaver, more muskrats, two actions at once, slow motion, any word after 7.2, silence in the tail, accented Russian, letters, cyrillic, subtitles, a glowing emblem, a logo, watermark, English speech, black bands
